newsitem.title: USA: Shiva names James Zucco president/COO.
newsitem.headline: Shiva names James Zucco president/COO.

text.p: Shiva Corp said Wenesday it appointed James L. Zucco Jr. as president and chief operating officer, effective immediately.
Zucco was formerly as president for network communications software at Lucent Technologies
He will be responsible for all of Shiva's worldwide operations and will report to Frank Ingari, Shiva's chairman and chief executive officer, the company said.
The company also said it intends intent to promote Zucco to the additional post of chief executive within about one year.
"We believe Jim will make a great CEO," said Ingari.

"Once he gets his arms around our particular business and decides how he wants to organize operations long-term, we'll make the transition. At that time I'll become an active operating chairman, working to support Jim on strategy, communications, and employee development."
Prior to joining Lucent, Zucco served as vice president and general manager of AT&T advanced network applications at AT&T Business Communications Services, part of AT&T Corp.

Founded in 1985, Shiva is a global provider of remote access solutions, systems, and services. Its products enable users and user sites to connect with corporate information resources, on-line services and the Internet.
